subject: IR drill — artifact index, retention clarifications, and SOC 2 evidence pull
messages:
From: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@novacorp.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: ops-security@finops.com
Date: 2026-12-13T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: IR drill artifact list + retention window for SOC 2 review

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for running yesterday's tabletop with our team — good discussion. As a follow-up for our compliance group, can you share the canonical list of artifacts Redwood produced during the drill and confirm retention windows we can reference in the SOC 2 evidence pull? Specifically we need:

- A CSV or spreadsheet of exported artifacts (logs, export timestamps, runbooks exercised)
- Retention policy text or pointer for forensic logs and telemetry (S3/Elasticsearch)
- Any redacted copies of notifications sent to customers (if applicable)

Our compliance deadline is next Tuesday; if you can get an index and a short note on retention/archival that would be very helpful.

Appreciate it —
Alice
Alice Johnson
Security Compliance Manager, NovaCorp
alice.johnson@novacorp.com

Attachment: none
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@novacorp.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-13T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: IR drill artifact list + retention window for SOC 2 review

Hi Alice —

Thanks for the note and glad the tabletop was useful. Quick answers and plan: 

1) Artifact index: we'll produce a CSV export listing each artifact type (alert IDs, log buckets, timeline snapshots, runbook versions, PagerDuty incident id references) and deliver it to you by EOD.
2) Retention windows: short summary below and I will attach the formal policy doc (SOC 2 evidence) in the follow-up email:
   - Forensic logs (raw): retained 180 days in access-controlled S3, archived to cold storage for up to 3 years for customers who opted in to extended retention.
   - Application telemetry (aggregated): 90 days hot, 12 months warm in our analytics cluster.
   - KV cache / ephemeral traces: 30 days.
3) Customer notifications: we have the template redacted notices used for the drill; we'll include one example in the evidence bundle.

Two clarifying Qs so we tailor the package:
- Do you need evidence cut by environment (prod vs staging) or a single combined index?
- Is a CSV + a PDF summary enough, or do you want the full exported runbook markdown files zipped?

Tagging Marissa and Neha to assemble the artifact index and attach the SOC 2 evidence listing.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Manager, Security & Compliance (on-call)
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Karthik / Alice —

Attached is the initial artifact index and a short evidence listing for SOC 2. Highlights below and notes on scope: 

- Attached: ir_artifact_index.csv — each row = artifact id, type, environment, owner, export path, export_timestamp.
- Attached: soc2_evidence_listing.pdf — one-page summary that maps drill artifacts to common SOC 2 control references (CC6.0, CC7.0).
- Drill notes (drill-notes.md) include the runbook versions exercised and a sanitized timeline; customer-facing notification template is included as an excerpt.

Scope and limitations: this package contains production artifacts only (we did not export staging telemetry). If you need staging copies we can produce them but that will add ~6 hours to the export job.

Retention summary (push from Karthik's note):
- Forensic raw logs: 180 days default; extension to 3 years when customer contract specifies extended retention (see policy link in PDF).
- Aggregated telemetry: 90 days hot, 12 months warm.
- Notifications & runbooks: retained indefinitely in our internal docs store with access controls; redacted public templates included in the package.

Attachments: ir_artifact_index.csv (CSV), soc2_evidence_listing.pdf (PDF), drill-notes.md (MD)

Let me know if you want the full runbook ZIP.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
